tools.name: query
tools.description:
Query the server logs. Sets all filters and visualization in one atomic call — every parameter is always applied together, so no stale state can carry over from a previous query.

FILTERS (all optional — omit or pass null to leave unfiltered):
  status     — HTTP status code: '200' | '201' | '301' | '304' | '401' | '403' | '404' | '500'
  method     — HTTP verb: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE' | 'PATCH' | 'HEAD' | 'OPTIONS'
  pathSearch — substring matched against the request URL path, e.g. '/api'
  dateFrom   — start date inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD (resolve "last week", "yesterday", etc. before calling)
  dateTo     — end date inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD

AGGREGATION (required):
  groupBy — dimension to group by: 'date' | 'status' | 'method' | 'path' | 'country' | 'user_agent'
  measure — metric to compute:    'count' (requests) | 'bytes' (bandwidth) | 'unique_ips'

CHART (required):
  chartType — 'line' (trends over time, best with groupBy=date) | 'bar_vertical' | 'bar_horizontal' | 'table' (raw rows, groupBy/measure ignored)

status.description: HTTP status filter. Omit for no filter.

method.description: HTTP method filter. Omit for no filter.

pathSearch.description: URL path substring filter. Omit for no filter.

dateFrom.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no lower bound.

dateTo.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no upper bound.

measure.description: Metric to compute: count (requests), bytes (bandwidth), or unique_ips.

chartType.description: Chart type. Use line for trends over time (best with groupBy=date). Use table for raw rows (groupBy/measure ignored).
